verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document enterprise identity authentication (SSO/SAML/OIDC) or authentication through a cloud platform such as Bedrock or Vertex. The only auth item is device-code login (`--device-auth`) for headless environments, an adjacent login method rather than enterprise identity. The custom-model config and a community OAuth proxy workaround do not qualify either.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
